What the best operators say.

From Shopify founders to teams posting daily on LinkedIn and X — real workflows, running in production.

Zero manual handoffs across tools

“We build agents for a living at Kortix — I don't endorse tools lightly. A new lead hits Gmail, Linear gets a ticket, Slack gets a ping, and a follow-up lands on the calendar. No glue code. No Zapier chain quietly dying at 2am. Describe the workflow once, it runs.”

MK

Marko Kraemer

CEO, Kortix

0 hrs spent on orders & stock ops

“Running Enzos on Shopify, I used to start every day buried in customer emails and constantly checking stock levels. ActRun handles all of it now — customer inquiries get answered automatically, and the moment inventory runs low it emails our supplier directly with a reorder. I only get notified when something actually needs a decision. Everything else just runs.”

JF

Jamie Finegold

Founder, Enzos

Beyond code: actions, briefs & follow-ups

“I use Codex and Claude Code when the output is code. When the output is an action, a research brief, a follow-up, or simply clarity on what to do next, I use ActRun.”

AM

Adam Mainz

Google

Automation that feels like having someone capable watching the room

Hand me a task to handle

Powerful because it works like you think, not like machines do.

ActRun can still talk about agents, tools, files, apps, schedules, and approvals. The details stay visible in a helpful Autopilot preview, so the next move is clear before anything runs.

Not a blank builder

From messy tasks to real progress

Show up with a tangled task, idea, or curiosity. ActRun responds with practical Autopilots—real progress from your first message.

Not just chat

See exactly what runs and where approval matters

Every Autopilot gives you the full picture: actual tasks run, which apps are connected, the first output you’ll see, and where you approve or review.

Useful surprise

Explore new ways to clear your workday

ActRun’s suggestions help you explore, improve workdays, build projects, and find new ways to get things done—with room for curiosity and creativity.
